rules.split_unit: whole dialogue and its four annotators; related normalized duplicate/proper-prefix dialogues remain in one connected group
rules.normalization: collapse whitespace; remove spaces adjacent to Chinese characters and between consecutive digits; preserve punctuation, case and turn roles
rules.slicing: all consecutive source/target turns, A->B and B->A, with original full history through source; N turns yield N-1 examples
rules.meme_distribution: sum confidence per meme_id divided by total confidence across paper1..paper4
rules.original_source_split: provenance only; source_split and split are the newly assigned split
